prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+4.6% average after noise correction), winning 2 of 3 tests while 1 test showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.1% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen, sign_in redesign, adoption redesign, and adoption new_flow changes, as only 1 test has been completed for each kind.
Predictions have generally been too high, though round 7 was underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -7.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.6% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Full bleed visual layout for pick friend screen: Redesign the friend selection screen with an immersive full-bleed layout showcasing pet options visually. (why: Adoption stage is the biggest bottleneck with only 60.9% conversion rate and a mean time of 1017s.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet care instructions screen before photo upload: Insert a photo setup guide screen before custom pet creation to ensure upload success. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during photo generation.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop companion quick start checklist flow: Transform the home intro screen into an interactive checklist layout for desktop pet interactions. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and multiple users were confused about how to control or hide their pet after onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for sign in screen: Redesign the sign-in screen using a focused spotlight layout to emphasize safe account restoration. (why: Sign-in step drops 19.6% of users and 8 support tickets noted missing pets when re-authenticating.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop progress timer notification on waiting screen: Show dynamic time estimate and ready notifications while waiting for pet generation. (why: The waiting step on home has a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Clear onboarding path selection headline copy: Update the choose path headline and body text to clearly explain fast catalog vs custom creation. (why: Choose path screen has high mean time (514s) compared to median (8s), indicating user hesitation.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Official adoption certificate seal badge: Add a verified companion digital seal badge component to the adoption certificate. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion in the funnel (60.9%); adding accomplishment signals boosts commitment.)
7: [finish, hint] Desktop pet interaction hint on home intro: Add an actionable hint component to home intro explaining how to control and speak to the desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to interact with, hide, or talk to the pet.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Two column layout for choose path screen: Format the path selection screen with a side-by-side two column layout. (why: 76.2% conversion on path selection leaves 23.8% drop-off; side-by-side comparison speeds up decisions.)
9: [sign_in, copy] Pet restore account sign-in hint: Add a hint to the sign-in screen informing users that logging in restores their existing pets. (why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after signing back into their accounts.)
